title: Ambulance Arrival
prompt: When an ambulance arrives, where is the patient taken?
hint: Name the hospital emergency area where doctors and nurses give immediate care.
sample: To the emergency room for immediate care.

ja.sample: 救急室に運ばれ、すぐに処置が行われます。
